description: This file declares the interface for a basic periodic timer mechanism, including function prototypes for initializing, destroying, adding, reloading, removing timers, checking the time to next timer, executing timers, and accessing private timer data.

methods.name: SYNC_TIMER_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys and cleans up the timer system.

methods.name: SYNC_TIMER_Add
methods.description: Adds a new timer with a callback, identifier, and callback time.

methods.name: SYNC_TIMER_Reload
methods.description: Reloads an existing timer with a new callback time.

methods.name: SYNC_TIMER_Remove
methods.description: Removes a timer given its callback and identifier.

methods.name: SYNC_TIMER_TimeToNext
methods.description: Returns the time remaining until the next scheduled timer.

methods.name: SYNC_TIMER_PRIV_GetVector
methods.description: Provides access to the private timer vector data.
